description: NOT A COMPOSER: doseedo plays music, it does not write it — YOU write the piece. Background music for a video or a brand film, an instrumental, a theme, a song: compose every part yourself as notes ([{pitch, start_beats, duration_beats, velocity}], beats from bar 1 — melody, harmony, bass, in the key and at the tempo you choose), then play them: doseedo_render_score {parts} for several instruments (one stem each, then doseedo_mix) or doseedo_render_midi for one; doseedo_instruments lists the players and their ranges; the steps: doseedo_recipes name="compose-piece" (to picture: "score-a-film"; one part in a session's key: "compose-part"). THIS tool is text to music from a PROMPT alone (optionally lyrics) with NO notes behind it: the instrument model then has nothing to play, and a take is often near-silent, a drone or clicks. Nothing in it is controlled — no key control (a key in the prompt is not honoured), no MIDI input, bpm/time_signature only tag the caption. Use it only when the user explicitly asks for a prompt-only AI sketch, listen before handing a take over, and never deliver one as the music. Async: job_id → doseedo_wait_task (typically 1–3 min) → audio URLs (pre-signed: curl -OJ <url>, no auth header, valid 24 h — see expires_at). Cancel: a render that has not reached the GPU yet is stopped and its credits refunded; one already rendering finishes on the GPU (its credits are spent), the job ends as canceled and the output is discarded.

bpm.description: Optional tempo HINT in BPM, written into the caption (default 120). Not enforced — the output tempo can drift from it.

duration_seconds.description: Target length in seconds (e.g. 30–120). Omit for the model default.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Any unique string for THIS request (e.g. a UUID). Re-sending the same call with the same key after a timeout returns the same job instead of starting a second one.

lyrics.description: Optional lyrics to sing. Omit for instrumental.

prompt.description: Style/mood/instrumentation prompt, e.g. "warm jazz trio, brushed drums, late-night ballad".

time_signature.description: Optional meter HINT written into the caption, e.g. "4/4", "3/4". Not enforced.

name: doseedo_generate_music
title: Prompt-only AI sketch (doseedo does not compose — you write the piece)
